description: This file defines the Language model class within the OpenCart system, specifically handling operations related to localisation languages including retrieving a language by ID or code, and listing all available languages.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: The Language class manages localisation languages, providing methods to retrieve individual languages by ID or code, and to list all active languages.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a language's details by its ID, using caching for performance.

methods.name: getLanguageByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a language's details by its code, using caching for efficiency.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all active languages, utilizing cache for optimization.
